title: Enel replacement plan
description: A two-part motion campaign for Enel Chile's 'Recambio' program — a government-backed initiative replacing old gas and electric appliances with efficient alternatives. Delivered as two separate explainer videos targeting residential customers across Chile.
challenge: Government energy programs are notorious for dry, compliance-driven communication. Enel needed to explain a complex multi-step program (eligibility, application, delivery, installation) in a way that felt accessible and motivating for everyday families.
solution: Designed a warm, character-driven visual language that centers real domestic environments. Clear iconography, step-by-step sequencing, and approachable voiceover pacing make even the bureaucratic steps feel manageable. Both videos were optimized for Facebook and YouTube pre-roll formats.
result: The Recambio program exceeded registration targets by 35% in the campaign period. Enel's regional communications team adopted the visual style as the standard for future residential campaign materials.
